package httptransport

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/domain"
)

func TestRevisionSummaryDTOUsesFrontendContractNames(t *testing.T) {
	summary := domain.RevisionSummary{Schema: "practice-task-revision-summary.v2", RevisionID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
		Digest: "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("a", 64), FamilyKey: "http-handler", VariantKey: "go-api",
		RevisionNumber: 3, Surface: "project", Title: "Repair the handler", Type: "BUGFIX",
		PublishedAt: time.Date(2026, 10, 1, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)}
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(revisionSummaryDTO(summary))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var got map[string]any
	if err := json.Unmarshal(encoded, &got); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for key, want := range map[string]any{
		"schema": "practice-task-revision-summary.v2", "revision_id": summary.RevisionID,
		"revision_digest": summary.Digest, "family_key": summary.FamilyKey, "variant_key": summary.VariantKey,
		"revision_number": float64(3), "surface_classification": "project", "scenario_title": summary.Title,
		"task_type": "BUGFIX", "published_at": "2026-10-01T12:00:00Z",
	} {
		if got[key] != want {
			t.Errorf("DTO[%s] = %#v, want %#v", key, got[key], want)
		}
	}
	for _, forbidden := range []string{"digest", "surface", "title", "type"} {
		if _, exists := got[forbidden]; exists {
			t.Errorf("domain-only field %q leaked into transport DTO", forbidden)
		}
	}
}

func TestCheckpointRequestRequiresExactFrontendBodyAndPath(t *testing.T) {
	stepID := "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
	valid := `{"schema":"practice-task-submit.v2","scope":"MILESTONE","milestone_id":"` + stepID + `"}`
	if _, err := decodeCheckpointRequest(httptest.NewRecorder(), jsonRequest(valid), stepID); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("valid checkpoint rejected: %v", err)
	}
	for name, body := range map[string]string{
		"wrong schema":        strings.Replace(valid, "practice-task-submit.v2", "wrong.v1", 1),
		"final scope":         strings.Replace(valid, `"MILESTONE"`, `"FINAL"`, 1),
		"different milestone": strings.Replace(valid, stepID, "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", 1),
		"unknown field":       strings.TrimSuffix(valid, "}") + `,"extra":true}`,
		"trailing JSON":       valid + `{}`,
	} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			if _, err := decodeCheckpointRequest(httptest.NewRecorder(), jsonRequest(body), stepID); err == nil {
				t.Fatal("invalid checkpoint request was accepted")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestReadinessReconciliationRequestIsVersionedAndStrict(t *testing.T) {
	valid := `{"schema":"practice-step-readiness-reconcile.v1"}`
	var payload struct {
		Schema string `json:"schema"`
	}
	if err := decodeStrict(httptest.NewRecorder(), jsonRequest(valid), &payload, maximumCommandBytes); err != nil || payload.Schema != "practice-step-readiness-reconcile.v1" {
		t.Fatalf("valid readiness body rejected: %+v, %v", payload, err)
	}
	for name, body := range map[string]string{
		"wrong schema":  `{"schema":"practice-learning-readiness-reconcile.v1"}`,
		"unknown field": `{"schema":"practice-step-readiness-reconcile.v1","decision":"READY"}`,
		"trailing JSON": valid + `{}`,
	} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			var got struct {
				Schema string `json:"schema"`
			}
			err := decodeStrict(httptest.NewRecorder(), jsonRequest(body), &got, maximumCommandBytes)
			if err == nil && got.Schema == "practice-step-readiness-reconcile.v1" {
				t.Fatal("invalid readiness body was accepted")
			}
		})
	}
}

func jsonRequest(body string) *http.Request {
	request := httptest.NewRequest("POST", "/", strings.NewReader(body))
	request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	return request
}
